text: 赛力斯9月15日晚间公告，公司于2026年9月15日通过上海证券交易所回购普通股154万股，占公司现有已发行股份的0.09%，回购价格区间为每股45.07元-46.10元，回购总金额为7031.29万元，本次回购股份拟用于注销。
text_en: Seres announced on the evening of September 15 that on September 15, 2026, the company repurchased 1.54 million ordinary shares through the Shanghai Stock Exchange, accounting for 0.09% of the company's existing issued shares, at a repurchase price range of 45.07 yuan to 46.10 yuan per share, with a total repurchase amount of 70.3129 million yuan. The repurchased shares are intended to be cancelled.
